Q1. What does “it” refer to in this repository?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow under .github/workflows/ — name the workflow file (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script or prompt under scripts/ or prompts/ — name the path (RECOMMENDED)
C. A documentation file such as README.md or agents.md — name the file/section
D. Something else in the repo — describe the exact component/path
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want for that target?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken or incorrect behavior — describe current vs expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change automation behavior — describe the exact new outcome (RECOMMENDED)
C. Improve speed, reliability, or cost — name the concrete pain point or metric
D. Improve wording/docs/usability — quote the text or section to change
Q3. What should we use to verify the change is correct?
Choices:
A. A specific failing workflow run, PR, log, or error message — provide the reference (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific before/after behavior — describe what should be different (RECOMMENDED)
C. A specific file/output/section should change — name it explicitly
